mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees (name, gender, age, phone, email, position_id, salary) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{positionId}, #{salary})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS e_id, e.name AS e_name, e.gender AS e_gender, e.age AS e_age, e.phone AS e_phone, e.email AS e_email, e.salary AS e_salary, e.position_id AS e_position_id, p.id AS p_id, p.position_name AS p_position_name, p.level AS p_level FROM employees e LEFT JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT e.id AS e_id, e.name AS e_name, e.gender AS e_gender, e.age AS e_age, e.phone AS e_phone, e.email AS e_email, e.salary AS e_salary, e.position_id AS e_position_id, p.id AS p_id, p.position_name AS p_position_name, p.level AS p_level FROM employees e LEFT JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.id ORDER BY e.name

SELECT e.id AS e_id, e.name AS e_name, e.gender AS e_gender, e.age AS e_age, e.phone AS e_phone, e.email AS e_email, e.salary AS e_salary, e.position_id AS e_position_id, p.id AS p_id, p.position_name AS p_position_name, p.level AS p_level FROM employees e LEFT JOIN positions p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY e.name
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, salary = #{salary}, position_id = #{positionId} WHERE id = #{id}
